frames.line: La luz del umbral seguía encendida.
frames.note: hook: the lit threshold and the snow, no actor; the light is the promise that has not gone out

frames.line: La vieja esperaba a alguien que no volvía.
frames.note: setup: the old woman at the door, the young lamplighter entering with his lantern
escalation: he reaches for the lamp; the woman turns to stop him
reaction: wordless close-up; the hand at the lamp is the cause, the face is the consequence

frames.line: Él dejó su propia luz en la nieve.
frames.note: reveal: he walks away; the set state shows his lantern left in the snow

frames.line: Y se fue sin decir nada.
frames.note: close: the woman stays, the young man is gone, and the second lantern is still lit in the snow
